title: Host the Dundie Awards at Chili's
description: Reserve the big table. Write custom awards. Do NOT let anyone drive home who has had one too many. Best. Show. Ever.

title: Prep quarterly numbers for the branch review
description: Corporate (Jan) is asking again. Ask Oscar to actually do the math. Would I rather be feared or loved? Easy — both.

title: Finish the screenplay: Threat Level Midnight
description: Agent Michael Scarn returns. Just need the golden bullet scene and the Scarn dance. It only took 11 years so far.

title: Update LinkedIn headline to 'World's Best Boss'
description: It's official — I bought the mug, so it's basically certified.

title: Plan the perfect proposal for Holly
description: Every candle in the office. All of them. Fire marshal be damned. She is my soulmate.

title: Call Mom on her birthday
description: Do not forget again. She still brings up 1998.

title: Sign up for the Second City improv class
description: Rule one of improv: never say no. Rule two: always have a gun in the scene.

title: Buy a replacement 'World's Best Boss' mug
description: The old one has a chip. A boss of my caliber cannot be seen with a chipped mug.

title: Renew the Sebring's registration
description: The convertible needs to be street legal before the next Scranton cruise. Little Kid Lover license plate frame stays.

title: Meet financial advisor about the condo
description: Two bed, two bath, second bedroom is a gym / recording studio / screening room. It has a Murphy bed AND a foldout couch.

title: Diversify out of Dunder Mifflin stock
description: Ryan says paper is dying. Ryan also invented WUPHF, so... hold. Maybe.

title: Start an emergency fund (goal: pay off Chili's tab)
description: Also budget for Pretzel Day. Do not underestimate Pretzel Day.

title: Declare bankruptcy
description: Just walk into the office and shout 'I DECLARE BANKRUPTCY!' Oscar says that's not how it works. Oscar is wrong.

title: Book the Sandals Jamaica trip
description: Waiting on the promo pricing before pulling the trigger. It's a big commitment. Bigger than the condo.
awaitNote: Waiting on the winter promo rate to drop and for a travel buddy to confirm

title: Get Toby transferred to Costa Rica
description: Corporate keeps stalling. NO, God! NO, God, please, NO!
awaitNote: Blocked by HR — waiting on Toby's transfer paperwork to clear
